config.sessionGranularity: hits deduped by haystack session id; NDCG@10 binary, full IDCG over all gold sessions

diagnostics.note: adapterVariants.* ORs the question's content tokens instead of matching the question verbatim. Different query than the method mandates; diagnosis only.

boundaries: lcm-x retrieval numbers require an embedding provider. dsh-lcm has no vector path wired in yet: searchSession is a case-insensitive regex over rendered event text with three orderings. Its only honest lcm-x counterpart is the fts arm (sR@5 0.20 / sR@10 0.36 / sNDCG 0.204).

Turn-level (session, turn_index) recall/NDCG is unavailable: LongMemEval_S ships only answer_session_ids, no per-turn evidence labels. No tR@k is reported for any arm; perQuestion.*.eventRank is a diagnostic (rank of the first event inside an evidence session), not turn-level recall.
Model = none. No answerer, no judge, no embedding model runs.
Session-level recall dedupes hits by session id, so repeated events from one session cannot consume the top-k budget.
n is disclosed per run: see dataset.scoredQuestions and the per-type n column.
